stories.title: Explainability Signal Normalization Layer
stories.description: Implement a normalization layer that converts raw provider (credentials, links) and clinical trial signals into a consistent explainability structure with fields for source, meaning, and limitations.

stories.title: Explainability Fallback and Missing Data Handling
stories.description: Define and implement fallback logic when explainability inputs are missing or partial, ensuring the system still produces safe, transparent explanations with explicit limitations.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering Contract for Explainability
stories.description: Define and enforce a frontend-safe rendering format for explainability content so that MessageBubble displays source, meaning, and limitations clearly without breaking markdown or chat UX.

stories.title: Explainability Aggregation Across Multiple Signals
stories.description: Implement logic in the evaluation facade to aggregate multiple explainability entries (e.g., credentials + external links + trial data) into a coherent, non-redundant explanation set for end users.
